source.provider: NOAA/National Weather Service, archived by NSF Unidata
source.attribution: Contains NOAA/NWS radar data. This visualization is not a NOAA or NWS product.

coordinates.description: Local spherical Mercator, scaled to meters at radar latitude; x east, y north. z is altitude above mean sea level.

processing.method: Barnes2 interpolation of dBZ, distance/beam radius of influence, minimum radius 700 m, nb=1, bsp=1.
processing.mask: Masked, invalid and antenna-transition gates are excluded. Grid points with no contributing observations or below radar altitude (388 m MSL) remain byte 0.
processing.quantization: 0.5 dBZ steps; values clipped to [-32, 95] dBZ. No reflectivity threshold is applied to the stored volume.
processing.limitations: One archived scan acquired over about four minutes. Interpolation is not a direct measurement at every voxel. No clutter, terrain or precipitation-type correction is performed. Missing coverage does not mean clear air.
